The six named people H, J, K, L, M, N are present, and every other seat is occupied by a different, unnamed person. Number seats from the left starting at 1. Shared clues: H sits second from the left. J sits exactly two seats to the right of H; K sits exactly two seats to the right of J; L sits exactly two seats to the right of K; M sits exactly two seats to the right of L; N sits exactly two seats to the right of M.

Question: Who occupies seat 4 from the left?
questions.explanation: The clues place the six named people at seats H=2, J=4, K=6, L=8, M=10, N=12. These positions fit every permitted row length 12–15; unnamed participants fill the other seats. The requested fact is the same in all four valid row lengths: J.
